changelog.zh: 对应官方 v2.4.1；保留 K 池支持、无盘恢复与逐卡抽水。PF 池固定 0%，其它池按当前签名策略为 1%；包含官方 30/40/50 系能效、显存锁频、GPU 编号和超频参数更新。
changelog.en: Matches official v2.4.1, with K Pool support, diskless recovery and per-GPU fee scheduling. PF Pool is fixed at 0%; other pools use the current signed 1% policy. Includes the official 30/40/50-series efficiency, memory-clock, GPU-numbering and overclock-option updates.
